title: 1st Grade for ME - Unit 4 - Communicating With Sound and Light
before:
In Unit 4, children build and harness scientific knowledge about how sound and light work. They ask questions about what they sense in their environment and about communication.

Weeks 1-3 - Learning focuses on sound 
Weeks 4-6 - Children explore how each phenomenon is produced, can change or be changed, and is used by people and other animals.

Children draw on their knowledge of animal structures from Unit 2 and their own experiences in the world to ground these otherwise hard-to-reach understandings.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 9 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 334 links on this page open a file — 299 PDF, 35 PowerPoint — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 1 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 7 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Let a colon do its own work
decisions.why: A colon marks the words before it as a term and the words after it as what the term means. 16 links sit immediately in front of a colon, where the chevron lands between the term and the punctuation that belongs to it. 16 format tags stand between a title and its description and move to the end of the row. No word changes and nothing is removed.

audit.opening: In Unit 4, children build and harness scientific knowledge about how sound and light work. They ask questions about what they sense in their environment and about communication. Weeks 1-3 - Learning focuses on sound Weeks 4-6 - Children explore how each phenomenon is produced, can change or be changed, and is used by people and other animals. Children draw on their knowledge of animal structures from Unit 2 and their own experiences in the world to ground these otherwise hard-to-reach understandings.
